I honestly can't believe I haven't left a review for this game yet. My one issue with Terraria is it can be rather grindy at times, especially if you want a specific item or weapon and sometimes the bosses can feel a little unfair when playing by yourself. Other than that, there is a reason it's been around for over 15 years and remains peak. The Villager Npc's feel a lot more than just shopkeepers having histories, lore, and even relationships with the other villagers. (which I love despite making it sometimes hard to plan houses for them all). This is definitely a game to play WITH friends, but can be just as fun with yourself. The vast amount of bosses, and weapons you can use to disperse them are definitely a huge plus, allowing for creative and often absurd solutions that fit for your playing style. 

I won't deny that you likely do need a wiki for progression or crafting while planning as while as cool as this game is, I won't deny that it isn't the most beginner friendly. (Personally I like that though). I feel it has a lot to offer, whether its building beautiful castles and creations, or battling against cosmic entities, or a fishing sim, there is something for everyone!
